name: nex-viewer
description: Utility for parsing and viewing NEX connections from packet captures

scripts.test:unix: npm run build:unix && npm run start
scripts.build:unix: npm run lint && npm run clean && npm run compile:unix && npm run browserify
scripts.compile:unix: npx tsc && npx tsc-alias && npm run copy-static:unix
scripts.copy-static:unix: npm run copy-html:unix && npm run copy-css:unix
scripts.test:win: npm run build:win && npm run start
scripts.build:win: npm run lint && npm run clean && npm run compile:win && npm run browserify
scripts.compile:win: npx tsc && npx tsc-alias && npm run copy-static:win
scripts.copy-static:win: npm run copy-html:win && npm run copy-css:win

author: Pretendo Network
